_doc: US cosmetic profile for scripts/check_copy.py, built on amazon-standard. Draft, unverified; awaiting human category compliance review and label verification before publication.

Cosmetic intake permits verified cosmetic product facts and sourced facts about an ingredient. An ingredient fact must not imply a finished-product result. The facts-and-images refuter checks that distinction and every source; regex checks cannot establish substantiation or image implications.

Drug, disease, device, health-effect and results claims remain prohibited. Quality, origin, testing and free-from copy needs exact brief approval and an evidence-backed facts.allow entry. Use, amounts and units must match the label.
No supplement structure/function disclaimer is imposed on cosmetic facts. The gate remains a mechanical check, not category compliance approval.
